svg.text: Device memory resident on the GPU, one movie
Every cudaMalloc/cudaFree on the device, accumulated. One movie holds ~3 GiB for most of its life and returns all of it at the end.
A100 80 GB: this run never exceeds 3.7% of the card. 436 allocations / 266 frees, 3.6 GiB of churn, and the whole reservation is torn down between movies.
